'''Berry''' is a [[troll]] that guards the prison in the [[Troll Stronghold (area)|Troll Stronghold]], and is featured in the [[Troll Stronghold]] quest. He holds the [[Cell key 2]], which is needed to open the cell where [[Eadgar]] is held.

Players can pickpocket him for the key if they have level 30 [[Thieving]], if not they must fight him.

He is normally sleeping, but if pickpocketing fails, he wakes up and starts fighting.

Berry and [[Twig (troll)|Twig]] both have a rare chance of dropping a crystal key half.
